final.summary: ETP power was at standby 11:35-14:20 with ETP inflow and outfall flow flat at zero, while equalization tank level rose from 0.46 to 0.66 and intake continued. Outfall pH stayed near neutral 7.29-7.49 and conductivity remained around 4983 uS/cm with no discharge. After restart at 14:20, ETP inflow and power returned to normal and a lab grab at 11:20 showed BOD 18.7 mg/L below the 30 mg/L limit. The tank balance shows 43.4 m3 unaccounted for during the stop, indicating water left the tank by a route other than the ETP or intake estimates are off.

result.note: ETP balance: treated flow reaching the outfall vs outfall flow (same time). Boundary balance: intake vs outfall + losses + sludge water + tank storage change (reuse cancels). Tank balance: wastewater arriving (estimated from intake) vs ETP inflow + storage change; unaccounted water left the tank another way, or was intake water that never became wastewater. null means a required signal is under 80% coverage.
